question: Kongampattu AV Murugaiyan, was conferred the Padma Shri Award in 2022 for his relentless pursuit in playing the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thavil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the year 2022, Govt of India conferred the **Padma Shri award on Murugaiyan** for his immense contribution to conserving the ancient Carnatic musical instrument Thavil.
 
• **Murugaiyan **was the only person from **Puducherry Union Territory** to be honored with a Padma award in the year 2022.
 
• Because of Murugaiyan's immense contributions to preserving the thavil instrument and his huge popularity as an exponent of Thavil, the name of the instrument "Thavil" has come to be associated with the name of the village where he was born. The village is commonly referred to as "**Thavil Kongampattu**".
 
• The award is in recognition of his service as a "**Renowned Thavil player and Guru from Puduchery** - Vidwan conserving the ancient **Carnatic musical instrument**.
